title: AI Video Prompt
description: A structured prompt schema for AI video models such as Sora 2 and Seedance 2.0. Interactive builder: https://sora-json-prompt-builder.dolphinstudio101.workers.dev/

model.description: Target model this prompt was tuned for.

subject.description: The main subject — state it first and concretely.

action.description: What the subject does over time. Motion is what makes it video.

environment.description: Setting / background that grounds the subject across frames.

motion.description: Camera movement, e.g. 'slow dolly in', 'orbit', 'drone aerial pullback'.

duration_seconds.description: Clip length. Most models stay coherent at 5–10s.

negative.description: What to avoid — text, logos, warping, extra limbs.
